system.description:
Revive: a character at Death's Door comes back conscious with 1 Health Point. One use only.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.156
system.summary: Revive: a character at Death's Door comes back conscious with 1 Health Point. One use only.

automation.note: Target the character at Death's Door before using it. They leave Death's Door at 1 HP and stay conscious, unlike a normal stabilise. A Cursed target can't heal, so the Director sets the 1 HP by hand if they allow the revive.
